relationships.subject: SIRT1
relationships.evidence_quote: It also plays a cerebroprotective role in various inflammatory diseases of the nervous system by inhibiting the activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome and the immune upstream regulator IL-18 of NLRP3

relationships.subject: Acupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: Acupuncture could increase the pain threshold of CPSP rats, promote the expression levels of SIRT1, reduce the expression levels of NLRP3 and IL-18, and reduce the pain symptoms of rats.

relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: the NLRP3 inflammasome in the brain tissue can also regulate the maturation and secretion of IL-18 and other cytokines

key_findings: In a rat central poststroke pain model, SIRT1 fell while NLRP3 and IL-18 rose; acupuncture reversed this and raised pain threshold.
The SIRT1 inhibitor EX527 reversed acupuncture benefit.
